zh: 打開檔案 → 全選 → 複製 → 貼進對話框。下一位同事再來一遍
en: Open file → select all → copy → paste into chat. Next colleague does it again

zh: 三位同事輪流登入同一個帳號,各自把同一份 brief 貼進新對話—像同一份稿印三份塞進同一個抽屜,改了誰也不知道哪份才算數
en: Three people take turns on one account, each pasting the same brief into a new chat—like printing the same draft three times into one drawer. After edits, nobody knows which copy counts

zh:
你已經記得那段文字長什麼樣子,因為貼太多次
→ 同一份材料(或同一帳號裡)貼第三次就升級
en:
You already know what that text looks like—you've pasted it too many times
→ Upgrade on the third paste of the same material (or in the same account)

zh: 把檔案附上(或放進 Project),對話中直接說「看那份的第三節」,不再貼內容
en: Attach the file (or drop it in Project). In chat, say “see section 3 of that file”—don't paste the body

zh:
有人問「我上次那份 spec 呢」,然後在對話紀錄裡翻半天
→ 同一套判斷在三個專案重複就升級
en:
Someone asks “where's that spec from last time?” then digs through chat history
→ Upgrade when the same judgment repeats across three projects

zh: 把重複的判斷寫成一份檔案放著;平常不附,AI 只看得到它的標題與用途,需要時才打開內容
en: Park repeated judgment in a file; don't attach it by default. AI only sees the title and purpose, and opens the body when needed

zh: 團隊共用的檢查清單做成 skill(例如無障礙檢查)—不用每次開會重講一遍規則,要用才叫出來
en: Team checklists become a skill (e.g. a11y review)—don't re-brief the rules every meeting; call it when you need it

zh:
你在不同專案重複解釋同一套標準
→ 流程需要跑腳本或產出檔案就升級
en:
You re-explain the same standard across projects
→ Upgrade when the flow must run a script or emit a file

zh: 不把內容搬進對話,讓 AI 直接讀那個檔案、並產出新檔案
en: Don't haul content into chat. Let AI read the file and emit a new file

zh: 用 Claude Code 直接讀專案檔、交出新檔—大檔不必再貼進共用帳號的對話裡把 context 洗爆
en: Use Claude Code to read project files and emit new ones—big files never paste into the shared-account chat and blow the context

zh:
你需要 AI 讀一個大到貼不進來的檔案,或要它直接交出檔案
→ 已屬課程 C4 範圍,講座只點到
en:
You need AI to read a file too big to paste, or to emit a file directly
→ That's course C4; this talk only flags it

en: It will just know which template to use

zh: 常常猜錯,或根本沒想到要用。像收件匣的自動分類規則—你設好了,信還是常常沒進到你要的那個資料夾
en: It often guesses wrong, or never thinks to use one. Like inbox rules—you set them, mail still misses the folder you wanted

zh: 重要的時候自己點名,別賭它會自己想到
en: When it matters, name it yourself. Don't bet it will think of it

zh: 每份範本名字清楚、各就各位
en: Each template has a clear name, in its place

zh: 同類名字擠在一起,連你自己都會選錯。就像 Drive 裡有五份「設計規範_最終版」,你打開的常常是錯的那份
en: Similar names pile up; even you pick the wrong one. Like five files named “design-spec_FINAL” in Drive—you open the wrong one

zh: 自己做的東西統一加前綴,一眼認得出哪個是你的
en: Prefix your own stuff so you can spot it at a glance

zh: 多裝一點沒差,反正用不到就不會動
en: Install more, no harm—unused ones just sit there

zh: 用不到的也要付錢養,更麻煩的是選項變多、它更容易挑錯。像桌面上放五十個捷徑,找東西反而變慢
en: You still pay to keep unused ones. Worse: more options, more wrong picks. Like fifty shortcuts on the desktop—finding anything gets slower

zh: 定期清掉沒在用的;清單越短,挑錯越少
en: Cull unused ones on a cadence; shorter list, fewer wrong picks

en: The same sentence sometimes fires, sometimes doesn't; in practice everyone falls back to an explicit / call

zh: 把自動觸發當「可能觸發」:關鍵步驟一律顯式呼叫,並在步驟卡明寫
en: Treat auto-trigger as “might fire”: explicit call on every critical step, written on the step card

zh: L1 很便宜,所以可以同時具備很多 skill
en: L1 is cheap, so you can keep many skills loaded

zh: 裝了 plugin 就整組常駐,清單不由你選;而真正的支出發生在誤觸發的 L2
en: Install a plugin and the whole set stays resident—you don't pick the list; the real spend is L2 misfires

zh: 省 token 的注意力從 L1 移到 L2 誤觸發;定期清掉不用的 plugin
en: Move token attention from L1 to L2 misfires; cull unused plugins on a cadence

zh: description 要同時寫清楚「做什麼」與「何時用」
en: description must state both “what it does” and “when to use it”

zh: 設計師照人類目錄直覺命名(critique / review / audit 邊界不清),模型分不出來就誤觸發
en: Designers name by human-folder instinct (critique / review / audit blur); the model can't tell them apart and misfires

zh: description 是寫給模型的觸發條件,不是寫給自己的目錄
en: description is a trigger condition for the model, not a folder label for you

zh: 積極使用漸進揭露:只有偶爾需要的內容放參考檔
en: Use progressive disclosure hard: rarely needed content goes in reference files

zh: 實務上把整份 guideline 塞進 SKILL.md 本體,每次觸發全額載入,漸進揭露形同失效
en: In practice the whole guideline gets stuffed into the SKILL.md body, full-load on every trigger; progressive disclosure is dead

zh: 本體只留判斷流程;清單、範例、模板一律移到參考檔
en: Keep only the judgment flow in the body; lists, examples, templates go to reference files

zh: 成本項
en: Cost item

zh: 現況 · prompt-only 慣性
en: Now · prompt-only habit

zh: 策略 · context-assisted
en: Strategy · context-assisted

zh: 決策層解讀(換算成錢)
en: Decision-layer read (in money)

zh: ① 每輪重貼
en: ① Re-paste every turn

zh: spec、guideline、素材每次對話重新貼上,每輪重複計費
en: spec, guideline, assets pasted fresh each chat; billed again every turn

zh: markdown substrate＋html view 成對持久化,對話附檔引用不重貼;agent 同時讀兩者整理 schema,一次結構化、多輪重用
en: Persist a markdown substrate＋html view pair; attach and cite, don't re-paste; the agent reads both, tidies schema, structure once, reuse across turns

zh: 月費方案下最大的隱形浪費;砍掉後同額度做更多輪迭代
en: Biggest hidden waste on a monthly plan; cut it and the same quota buys more iteration rounds

zh: ② 重造基準
en: ② Rebuild the baseline

zh: 自己整理 design guidelines 餵給模型,教它已經會的東西
en: You compile design guidelines and feed the model things it already knows

zh: 不付錢請模型讀它已經會的東西;教材維護量同步下降
en: Don't pay the model to read what it already knows; teaching-material upkeep drops with it

zh: ③ 整份塞入
en: ③ Stuff the whole file

zh: 完整文件、整包截圖直接丟進對話
en: Whole docs and screenshot dumps go straight into chat

zh: 分層壓縮:只給任務需要的層(C1 Tier 分層 → C4 Harness L1–L5 壓縮的講座版)
en: Layered compression: only the layers the task needs (talk version of C1 Tier split → C4 Harness L1–L5 compression)

zh: 帳單與品質同時改善—context 越乾淨,輸出越穩,返工輪次下降
en: Bill and quality both improve—cleaner context, steadier output, fewer rework turns

zh: 操作步驟 A · S0 → S1 建立你的 Substrate
en: Steps A · S0 → S1: build your Substrate

zh: EPSS 1 → 3 · 隨 T9 資料包附步驟卡
en: EPSS 1 → 3 · Step card ships with the T9 pack

zh: 需要 POC 可視化或跟人溝通時,請 AI 從文字檔生成 html—html 是給人看的畫面;勿把同一段內文再重貼進對話。
en: When you need a POC view or a human-readable screen, have AI generate html from the text file—html is the screen for humans; don't re-paste the same body into chat.

zh: 操作步驟 B · S1 → S2 升級成 Skill
en: Steps B · S1 → S2: promote to a Skill

zh: EPSS 3 → 4 · 不是所有東西都該變 skill
en: EPSS 3 → 4 · Not everything should become a skill

zh: 本體只寫判斷流程(控制在一頁內);清單、範例、模板移到參考檔,讓它只在真正需要時才載入。
en: Body holds only the judgment flow (one page max); lists, examples, templates go to reference files so they load only when needed.

zh: 關鍵步驟用顯式呼叫,不賭自動觸發;跑一次確認載入的確實是你要的那一個,再納入日常工作流。
en: Critical steps use an explicit call—don't bet on auto-trigger. Run once, confirm it loaded the one you wanted, then put it in the daily flow.

zh: 3.4 · 證據分層:誰的數字可以信
en: 3.4 · Evidence layers: whose numbers you can trust

zh: 現場版控制在 3 分鐘,而且用你最熟的那件事開場:
en: Live version stays under 3 minutes, and open with the thing you know best:

zh: 白話版 · 對號入座 · 現場主講用
en: Plain talk · Find your seat · Live delivery

zh: 這一級特有的風險
en: Risk unique to this level

zh: 一個動作
en: One move

zh: 一句帶走
en: One-line takeaway

zh:
EPSS 2
能解釋
en:
EPSS 2
Can explain

zh: 最危險的一級:能流暢轉述、卻無實作可校準,是二手數字的主要傳播節點
en: The most dangerous level: fluent retell, no practice to calibrate against—main relay node for second-hand numbers

zh: 轉述前先標注層級—機制 / 效果 / 判斷;標不出來就不轉述
en: Label the layer before you retell—mechanism / effect / judgment; if you can't label it, don't retell it
